title: SweepEvent
description: An event object representing a confirmed Liquidity Sweep. Part of the Event/Tracker/Evaluator separation that resolves the circular dependency between Liquidity Sweep and Mitigation/Efficient Price — see Domain_Model/Event_Model.md.

classification.description: GRAB is a sub-type of SWEEP (single-candle case); CONTINUATION means the precondition/pattern was not met.

opposing_pool_id.description: Links to the LiquidityPool instance swept through first.

target_pool_id.description: Links to the LiquidityPool instance being driven toward.

confirmed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the close that confirmed the reversal.

precondition_check.description: Efficient Price status for prior sweeps on 4H+ at the time this sweep was evaluated.

observability.description: The zone-entry/close-based reversal is CALCULATED; the claim this reflects deliberate market-maker action is INFERRED.
